gen-gf-autour-one-gf-inter-tight: Round, loud and bendy like tubing. Inter Tight follows in a plain sans with short ascenders and curve tails held back, while Autour One earns its keep when set big and brief.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-kedebideri: Autour One draws every letter with one stroke width, like laser-cut sheet, and that makes it a bold display voice. Kedebideri does the quieter job, with a skyward x-height and rounded letters that stay open and inviting.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-khula: Khula has a tall midsection, like a squat brush-pen belly, and curves that hold their mouths open. And Autour One, drawn in plain, unshaded lines, earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-kufam: Kufam runs a single track width like neon tubing, with generously open curves and ascenders that hardly show. Autour One handles the loud, expressive work; the sans handles the line itself.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-lexend: Approachable is the first word for Lexend, with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve. Autour One brings the bold, expressive punch, and the pair's strongest quality is how clearly it separates display from plain sans.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-lexend-deca: A clear channel leads into each round letter of Autour One, with hardly any step from capital to lowercase. And Lexend Deca stays plain and unshaded, its small-looking capitals sitting beside big lowercase while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-liter: Autour One is expressive and bold, with a clear channel into every round letter. Liter has no stroke contrast at all, and its tall lowercase and wide-mouthed rounds give the heading something quiet to lean against on the page.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-mada: Strokes of constant width, like bent pipe, give Autour One its bold, expressive look. And Mada, a plain sans with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, is the one whose size you can nudge up for comfort.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads open and modern, with generous curves and a high mean line across every word. And Autour One, traced as if with a marker, takes the bold lead above that sans.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-matangi: Matangi reads contemporary and sturdy, its strokes like twine pressed flat, with rounded letters left open and a hefty lowercase. Autour One feels louder and rounder beside it.
